title: Does Fine-Tuning a Shared Base Inherit Its Blind Spots? A LoRA Replication

original_idea.body: Do LoRA fine-tunes of one open base retain correlated failures from the base? (arXiv:2506.07962).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: inherited correlated failures is the concrete mechanism behind foundation-model concentration risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Lightweight LoRA + error-correlation measurement; guided methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (base-vs-descendant correlation), bounded LoRA training.

low_compute.reasoning: A few small LoRA fine-tunes + inference; single-GPU days.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Inherited-blind-spot claim rarely demonstrated this cheaply.
